problems.summary: Installing it stopped in its update loader at the first write and left the FM-1 in update mode.
problems.details: Installed from the FM-1 Firmware Hub in FM-1 Manager on an iPhone, on an FM-1 with the newer flash chip (B36014) running fm1-dock 0.9.0. The update loader was staged and ran, read the package, and its USB went away at the start of its write; the FM-1 stayed in update mode (ota-FM-1_727). Resuming from a Mac with fm1-dock's reference installer stopped the same way. The firmware itself runs once written another way.
problems.recovery: Written with M-Flasher on a computer, through the chip's own download mode.
